description_from_user: All four trials were simulated by moving the board by hand. Trial 4: slow movement, vigorous shaking for approximately 2–3 seconds, holding still in the hands, then slowly placing the board on a table. No human fall was recorded. Exact event timestamps were not annotated.

feature_definitions.msd: Saved firmware mean of squared successive filtered XYZ differences.
feature_definitions.abs_slopes: Absolute value of saved five-point least-squares signed slope.
feature_definitions.msd_mean_windows: Mean of saved MSD in (t-window,t]; partial startup windows excluded.
feature_definitions.time_origin: First recorded board_time_ms in each session.
